source_en: Home from the workshop. Lost track of time.
Home to Irakli before his night shift.
Dropping a client's car at the yard.
Night shift at the post office, sorting mail.
Taking my car to a mechanic. Engines baffle me.
Selling my books. Never had time to read.
Oh, sorry! I was miles away. My documents, officer.
Do you ever feel we're all characters in a very long novel?
Thanks! Look up at the clouds sometimes, officer.
A room of my own? Maybe I'll finally finish that chapter.
These walls have such a particular texture. Very honest.
So many more pages… left in the chapter…
I hope someone… tends the plants… on my windowsill…
Where are you coming from?
The south row workshop. The light through the roof makes me lose time.
Night shift at the Rustaveli bakery ovens. Engines were never my thing.
Are you experiencing any symptoms?
Fine, I think. Grease burns on the knuckles, but that's the job.
Nothing. Clean hands, see? I haven't touched an engine in a year.
The light on the rooftops this morning was extraordinary.
The smog turns the river this incredible amber colour.
